verse.verse_1: Whereof do they question one another?
verse.verse_3: Concerning which they are in disagreement.
verse.verse_4: Nay, but they will come to know!
verse.verse_5: Nay, again, but they will come to know!
verse.verse_6: Have We not made the earth an expanse,
verse.verse_8: And We have created you in pairs,
verse.verse_9: And have appointed your sleep for repose,
verse.verse_10: And have appointed the night as a cloak,
verse.verse_11: And have appointed the day for livelihood.
verse.verse_12: And We have built above you seven strong (heavens),
verse.verse_13: And have appointed a dazzling lamp,
verse.verse_14: And have sent down from the rainy clouds abundant water,
verse.verse_15: Thereby to produce grain and plant,
verse.verse_17: Lo! the Day of Decision is a fixed time,
verse.verse_18: A day when the trumpet is blown and ye come in multitudes,
verse.verse_19: And the heaven is opened and becometh as gates,
verse.verse_20: And the hills are set in motion and become as a mirage.
verse.verse_23: They will abide therein for ages.
verse.verse_24: Therein taste they neither coolness nor (any) drink
verse.verse_25: Save boiling water and a paralysing cold:
verse.verse_27: For lo! they looked not for a reckoning;
verse.verse_28: They called Our revelations false with strong denial.
verse.verse_29: Everything have We recorded in a Book.
verse.verse_30: So taste (of that which ye have earned). No increase do We give you save of torment.
verse.verse_31: Lo! for the duteous is achievement -
verse.verse_33: And voluptuous women of equal age;
verse.verse_35: There hear they never vain discourse, nor lying -
verse.verse_36: Requital from thy Lord - a gift in payment -
verse.verse_37: Lord of the heavens and the earth, and (all) that is between them, the Beneficent; with Whom none can converse.
verse.verse_38: On the day when the angels and the Spirit stand arrayed, they speak not, saving him whom the Beneficent alloweth and who speaketh right.
verse.verse_39: That is the True Day. So whoso will should seek recourse unto his Lord.
verse.verse_40: Lo! We warn you of a doom at hand, a day whereon a man will look on that which his own hands have sent before, and the disbeliever will cry: "Would that I were dust!"
